count_contract.accepted_rows: Includes 40 later-delivery corrections; excludes duplicate and rejected rows.
count_contract.checksums: SHA-256 of exact CSV file bytes. Paths are relative to the output data directory. Manifest excludes itself to avoid recursive hashing.
count_contract.curated_rows: One latest accepted delivery per firm/month; rejected newer candidates never replace it.
count_contract.expected_quality: Derived from explicit generation annotations, independently of any production parser.
count_contract.line: One-based physical CSV line; the header is line 1.
count_contract.monthly_totals: Computed directly from planned valid winners with integer cents, before CSV serialization; includes corrections.
count_contract.raw_rows: Metric CSV data rows only; excludes headers and the 500 master rows.

provenance: Entirely procedural fictional identities, locations and measurements; no source records used. DEMO tax IDs are intentionally non-real.

schemas.legacy_other_revenue: absent in v1; blank in v2 corrections for months before 2025-11 means structural zero
